intent_en: To demonstrate that a majority of Americans had received a COVID-19 vaccine by August 2021.
previous_intent: To illustrate the substantial increase in the percentage of U.S. adults who have received at least one dose of a COVID-19 vaccine, reaching a majority by August 2021.
narration_support: Our data from August, 2021 finds a majority of Americans say they've received a vaccine for COVID -19.
chart_support: Line chart showing the percentage of U.S. adults who received at least one dose of a vaccine increasing from February 2021 to August 2021.
evidence_note: The narration explicitly states the finding of a majority receiving the vaccine in August 2021, which aligns with the chart's title and upward trend from Feb '21 to Aug '21.
